#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 998244353;

ll modPow(ll a, ll e) {
    ll res = 1;
    a %= MOD;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int n; ll k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<ll> fac(n+1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fac[i+1] = ( (ll)(i+1) * fac[i] ) % MOD;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int k1 = (int)k;
    int c = n - k1;
    ll ans = fac[n];
    ans = ans * modPow(fac[c], MOD-2) % MOD;
    ans = ans * modPow(fac[n-c], MOD-2) % MOD;
    
    ll tem = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
        ll tem1 = fac[c];
        tem1 = tem1 * modPow(fac[i], MOD-2) % MOD;
        tem1 = tem1 * modPow(fac[c-i], MOD-2) % MOD;
        tem1 = tem1 * modPow(c-i, n) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            tem = (tem1 + tem) % MOD;
        } else {
            tem = (tem - tem1 + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    ans = ans * tem % MOD;
    ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
